race.comment: VITTOZZI (9) has been getting through the line well without threatening in her two runs this prep, both over 1000m. Has an awkward gate to contend with but she gets her chance to shine stepping up to 1200m on this roomy track. AUSBRED HED'N'TAIL (2) is back for a second campaign off a five-month lay-off. Started favourite and scored on debut over this distance at Gosford then did a good job in Class 1 company at the only other appearance. Two recent trials should have him up for this. HEROIC DEED (3) last raced when beaten narrowly over 1250m at the Beaumont track in January after winning on debut the start prior. Trialling in good style and is well and truly up to this. STAKEHOLDER (1) returned from an eight-month spell with a tidy win over this trip at Kembla recently. Lightly raced gelding who looks to be in for a fine campaign. DAMASCUS CALLING (10) returned in good shape at Gosford last time and will relish a longer journey on this more spacious circuit.
